title: Legacy Manifest
description: The legacy prefix of each public chain — every row written before sealing shipped — served verbatim with a digest over exactly these bytes. Two chain segments: identity_log (key rotations and moderation events) and treasury (rent and hosting entries). Both are outside cryptographic coverage: the chain commits to nothing below sealed_from_id, so nothing detects an edit to them today. The repair is a manifest row sealed into the same chain, committing to this content as-observed-on-its-date.
